## Source
.design/m5/49-hardware-token-signing.md — REQ-2 (mode 2) + decomposition PR 5.

## Surface
- New workspace member: `polaris-signer/`
- `polaris-signer/src/main.rs` — daemon entry
- `polaris-signer/src/pkcs11.rs` — PKCS#11 backend (same `cryptoki` as #165)
- `polaris-signer/src/rpc.rs` — `tonic` server over TLS-mutual-auth (Q6-A)
- Shared proto crate: `polaris-signer-proto/` — gRPC schema (Sign / Health / Status RPCs)

## Daemon flow
1. Boot: read PIN from terminal (`rpassword`), `secrecy::SecretString` for the lifetime of the daemon
2. Open PKCS#11 session, login, cache it
3. Start tonic server with TLS-mutual-auth (cert pinned in config)
4. Per RPC: lookup token, optional touch prompt (if FIDO2), C_Sign, return signature
5. On token disconnect / SIGINT: close session cleanly, alert connected clients via gRPC server-shutdown

## Rust-quality notes
- Per rust-quality §3 (binary): anyhow at main; thiserror in library boundaries.
- **TLS-mutual-auth via `rustls`** — pinned certs in config. Per rust-quality §5 (security): NEVER `WebPkiVerifier::dangerous_disable_certificate_verification()`. Cert pinning is hand-rolled with checked rotations.
- **PIN handling**: `secrecy::SecretString` from `rpassword`, never logged, never `Debug`-printed. Per AC-7.
- **Token disconnect detection**: PKCS#11 sessions return `CKR_DEVICE_REMOVED` on subsequent calls. Per rust-quality §10: poll the session periodically OR detect on next C_Sign call; emit a gRPC server event to connected clients.
- Per rust-quality §10: per-RPC concurrency bounded by `tokio::sync::Semaphore` (one sign at a time per token — PKCS#11 sessions are NOT thread-safe per call without locking).

## External references
- `tonic` server: https://github.com/hyperium/tonic/blob/master/examples/src/helloworld/server.rs
- `rustls` mutual auth: https://docs.rs/rustls/latest/rustls/server/
- PKCS#11 token disconnect events: https://docs.oasis-open.org/pkcs11/

## Acceptance
- [ ] `polaris-signer` binary builds + runs against softhsm2.
- [ ] Backend (with realtime mode config) connects via mutual TLS, completes a sign RPC end-to-end.
- [ ] Manually `lsof` the daemon confirms NO PIN string in process command line / environment.
